'''Takkan Russco''' was a infamous [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. He was a captain in the [[Crimson Fang]] gang, which following the death of [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] and formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]] took over [[Port Nowhere]] by force, planning to use the mobile space station as their base of operations. The Alliance send a strike team on a mission to liberate Port Nowhere, who systematically rid the station of Outer Rim's most notorious villains, confronting Takkan Russco and killing him.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Takkan Russco appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a boss during the "Crimson Fang" Uprising. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
